# heytownhall_organization (Resource)

The organisation's name. A token belongs to one organisation, so there is exactly one of these, and it already exists: creating the resource renames it.

Destroying the resource only removes it from the Terraform state. It does not delete the organisation and it does not change the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Renames the organisation. Destroying this resource changes nothing remotely.
resource "heytownhall_organization" "this" {
  name = "Acme Civic Research"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The organisation's name, as invoices and the dashboard show it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organisation's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the organisation's id.
terraform import heytownhall_organization.this 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
